name: GENMDDJ Web Player
description: Render a .gmdj through the real ROM and a WebAssembly build of Genesis Plus GX, right in your browser. Full stereo mix or all 10 individual hardware-voice stems, nothing uploaded anywhere. Stem export isn't possible on the hardware itself.

name: Palette Patcher
description: Edit the 8 UI palettes. Click a swatch or type a hex value, snaps to the nearest real Sega colour. Copy/paste and reorder slots, export all 8 at once.

name: Instrument Patcher
description: Edit the 32 FM patches with a piano audition. Runs standalone (no ROM needed) or patches a .bin directly. Imports/exports .gmi, .tfi, .vgi, and Ableton Operator .adv, plus rips instrument patches straight out of a .vgm game log.

name: Kit / Sample Patcher
description: Drum kits and sample pads: trim, gain, tanh, fade per pad. Drop .wav files straight onto pads. Import/export a single kit as a re-editable .genkit, no ROM required.

name: Wave Editor
description: Edit the 16 wavetables (32-step, 8-bit) with canvas drawing, presets, and a live math expression field. Drop a .bin to edit the factory default waves, or a .gmdj to edit one song's.

name: Font Patcher
description: Pixel-edit the 8×8 UI font, 96 glyphs plus an auto-derived inverse set. System-font import, presets, ROM-patches a .bin directly or saves for a build-time bake.

name: Settings Cloner
description: Carry your customizations from an old ROM onto a freshly built newer one: palettes, FM instruments, font, wavetables, drum kit/samples, and boot defaults (video/clock region, sync mode, clone depth, audition, hints). Pick exactly which categories to clone.

name: Save Tool
description: Extract .gmdj songs out of a cart save, checksum-validated. Edit config, build a new save from scratch, browse songs/chains/phrases/instruments.

name: Bank Editor
description: Edit the 32-slot SRAM instrument bank shared across songs. Load/save .gmi per slot, clear, bulk-fill. Config and songs are left untouched.

name: De-Re-Interleaver
description: Convert a save file between EverDrive's 64 KB odd-byte-interleaved format and the plain 32 KB logical layout, in either direction.

name: als2genmddj
description: Ableton .als and Standard MIDI .mid to .gmdj, and back. Also plain-text MML to .gmdj. Converts Ableton Operator FM patches to YM2612 patches and back too.
